children: Summit Therapeutics noted partner Akeso reported ivonescimab achieved a statistically significant overall survival benefit vs pembrolizumab in the Phase III HARMONi-2 study.
Akeso’s HARMONi-2 Phase III preplanned OS analysis showed ivonescimab monotherapy statistically improved overall survival vs pembrolizumab.
HARMONi-2 was a randomized, double-blind, multi-center study in China; data were generated, managed and analyzed by Akeso.
Results from the OS analysis are scheduled for presentation at an upcoming medical conference.
Ivonescimab (SMT112 in Summit territories) is approved and commercially available in China but remains investigational in Summit’s license territories, including the US and Europe.
